nodes.summary: Two labeled directed graphs $G$ and $H$ with the same vertex set, edge set and label set are equal if they have the same source map, the same target map and the same label map.
nodes.title: Extensionality for labeled directed graphs

nodes.summary: A labeled directed graph with vertex set $V$, edge set $E$ and label set $L$ consists of a source map $s : E \to V$, a target map $t : E \to V$ and a label map $\ell : E \to L$; the edge $e$ goes from $s(e)$ to $t(e)$ and carries the label $\ell(e)$. Loops and parallel edges are allowed.
nodes.title: Labeled directed graph

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a labeled directed graph, $p$ a predicate on its vertices, and $e$ an edge of $G$ whose source and target satisfy $p$, viewed as an edge of the restriction of $G$ to $p$. The label of $e$ in the restriction is its label in $G$.
nodes.title: Label of an edge in a restriction

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a labeled directed graph, $p$ a predicate on its vertices, and $e$ an edge of $G$ whose source and target satisfy $p$, viewed as an edge of the restriction of $G$ to $p$. The source of $e$ in the restriction, viewed as a vertex of $G$, is the source of $e$ in $G$.
nodes.title: Source of an edge in a restriction

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a labeled directed graph, $p$ a predicate on its vertices, and $e$ an edge of $G$ whose source and target satisfy $p$, viewed as an edge of the restriction of $G$ to $p$. The target of $e$ in the restriction, viewed as a vertex of $G$, is the target of $e$ in $G$.
nodes.title: Target of an edge in a restriction

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a labeled directed graph with vertex set $V$ and label set $L$, and let $p$ be a predicate on $V$. The restriction of $G$ to $p$ is the labeled directed graph with label set $L$ whose vertices are the vertices $v$ of $G$ with $p(v)$, whose edges are the edges of $G$ whose source and target both satisfy $p$, and in which each edge has the same source, target and label as in $G$.
nodes.title: Restriction of a labeled directed graph

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
